title: Rails and shared motion services
summary: Headless fixed kernel with independently replaceable providers.

blocks.text: builtin.motion requires core.motion@^1.0.0 and supplies motion, orbits, bodies, surfaces and rails at version 1.0.0. Each singleton can be selected independently. The editable provider selects the existing fixed shared kernel: numerical thrust/contact, analytic two-body coasting, body frames/SOI, surface/water queries and conservative rails wake scheduling. There is no copied physics kernel, per-view step or new numerical model.

World composition passes selected providers into context creation. Context model identities and supported capabilities govern analytic diagnostics, prediction and safe rails sleep. A replacement without a verified compatible rails binding retains ordinary numerical flight and cannot claim analytic sleep. Missing required core.motion is an error; unsupported provider failures are not optional absence.

The explicit legacy adapter preserves builtin.motion 0.1.0 v1 manifest, locks, service references and existing saves. The v2 archive is recognized as builtin only through the shipped catalogue exact digest; recognition does not grant execution consent. Fork edited source into a creator namespace and rebuild. New package graph/save identity is explicit; do not silently replace an old save lock. Dynamic celestial state, N-body solver policies and model selection remain separate gates.
